description: This file is a bundled JavaScript module exporting an AMP HTML validator with functions for URL/file reading, validation, and command-line interface handling.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Class for AMP HTML validation, instantiating with validator script content and providing validateString method.

classes.name: ValidationResult
classes.description: Class representing the result of validation, including status and errors.

classes.name: ValidationError
classes.description: Class representing individual validation errors with severity, location, message, and code.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Class for command-line interface command parsing and execution.

methods.name: hasPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a string has a specific prefix.

methods.name: isHttpOrHttpsUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL string starts with http:// or https://.

methods.name: readFromReadable
methods.description: Reads data from a readable stream.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Validator instance from script URL or file.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Validator instance from script content.

methods.name: logValidationResult
methods.description: Logs validation results to stdout or stderr.
